_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 3: the password check menu and editor ($870D-$8B6A). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Check menu cursor start (sprite 1)
regions.description: `54 00 00 50`: y, tile, attribute, x.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): draw the menu
regions.description: A window (`JSR $8BB3`, X = 14, Y = 7) at PPU `$20E8`, then the inline strings **GO OUT** at `$214B` and **WORD CHECK** at `$218B`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): GO OUT
regions.description: `JSR $C06F`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): WORD CHECK
regions.description: `JSR $C06F`.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): the cursor sprite
regions.description: The 4 bytes at `$870D` (`54 00 00 50`: y `$54`, tile 0, attribute 0, x `$50`) are copied to sprite 1 (`$0204-$0207`).

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): loop: flicker
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): loop: Down, Up or Select
regions.description: `JSR $C0E4` (the new presses): bits 2, 3, 5 go to `$875D`.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): loop: A, B or Start
regions.description: None of them loops. Otherwise **the result is the cursor's y compared with `$54`: Z set = the first item, GO OUT.**

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): result
regions.description: `LDA $0204 / CMP #$54 / RTS`. The callers (`$8347`, `$8379`) leave on Z.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): move the cursor
regions.description: y `$54` <-> `$64`: the cursor jumps between the two lines.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): WRONG WORD
regions.description: `JSR $8783` (clear the message rows) and fall into the string `0A 21 8A 'WRONG WORD'` (at PPU `$218A`) in `$8772`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): the string
regions.description: `JSR $C06F`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear the message rows (`$8783`)
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear: window
regions.description: (`$87F2` enters here with another address) X = 14, Y = 0, A = 0: `JSR $8BB3` draws a blank window;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear: up a row
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear: second window
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear: up a row
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): clear: third window
PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): the field is wrong (`$87B5`)
regions.description: Called when the check fails (carry set from `$887F`): `JSR $8B7E`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): wrong: the windows
regions.description: A window at `$2148` (X = 14, Y = 7), the string WRONG WORD (`$8772`),

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): wrong: THE ABOVE
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `09 21 CA 'THE ABOVE'`,

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): wrong: WORD IS RIGHT
regions.description: `JSR $87FB`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): wrong: the right word
regions.description: The 32 characters kept at `$0740` (the password the game would give) are drawn at PPU `$2086` with `$8681`.

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): the field is right (`$87F2`)
regions.description: `$19:$18` := `$2208` and the blank windows (`$8789`), then the string

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): WORD IS RIGHT
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `0D 22 0A 'WORD IS RIGHT'`;

regions.name: PASSWORD CHECK MENU (`$8711`, called by `$832D`'s screen): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): grid cursor -> character (`$880F`)
regions.description: The grid cursor sprite (`$0207` x, `$0204` y): x - 8 when x >= `$80` (the gap between the two halves), + `$D0`, >> 4 = the column 0-9; (y + `$D0`) >> 4 = the row 0-6; **`$16` := column + 10 x row**, the character 0-63. The grid is columns at x = 48, 64, 80, 96, 112 | 136, 152, 168, 184, 200 and rows at y = 48 ... 144, 16 apart (RUN).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): field cursor -> position (`$8839`)
regions.description: The field cursor sprite (`$020B` x, `$0208` y): x >> 3 - 6, then -1 from 5, -2 from 10 and -1 from 13 (undoing the blanks between the groups of four); **`$17` := the position 0-15, + 15 + carry when y = `$C8` (the second row)**; so the field is two rows (y = 184 and 200) of 16 characters 8 px apart.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): cursor flicker (`$8864`)
regions.description: `INC $41`; the colour `$018D` := `$8877[$41 AND 7]` (`30 10 00 0C 0F 0C 00 10`) and a palette update (`$017F` := 3): **the cursors blink through grey and blue.**

regions.name: Editor cursor flicker colours
PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the grid and the cursors
regions.description: `JSR $8B23` (draw the grid) and `JSR $8B0F` (put the two cursor sprites at their start: the grid cursor at x `$30`, y `$30`; the field cursor at x `$30`, y `$B8`).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): loop: flicker
PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): loop: the buttons
regions.description: `JSR $C0E4` (new presses) -> `$0457`; **bit 6 of `$0457` is also set while B is held**.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): loop: auto-repeat
regions.description: A new press resets the hold counter `$0458`; held, it counts, and after 20 frames the held direction `$F7` AND 15 is added to `$0457` every 15 frames: **a held direction repeats after 20 frames, then every 15**.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): loop: click
regions.description: A non-empty `$0457` plays sound `$33`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): loop: act
regions.description: `$0458` := Y; `JSR $893E` (a move); `JSR $88C7` (A); `JMP $8885`. The loop ends only through `$893B`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): A pressed?
PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): no
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): A: mark and click
regions.description: Bit 6 of `$0457` is set - **so that the move routines called next (`$8A93` forward, `$8A0B` back) act on the FIELD cursor, as when B is held**; `$8909` clears it again - and sound `$34` plays.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): A on the bottom row?
regions.description: The grid cursor at y `$90` goes to `$891E`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): A on a character
regions.description: `JSR $880F`; `$0411 + $17` := `$16` (the character at the field position) and `JSR $8681` draws it at `$22A6`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): after a character: the end of the field?
regions.description: Both cursors at `$C8` (the last position): the grid cursor jumps to `END` (x `$C0`, y `$90`, `$8912`); otherwise `JSR $8A93` moves the field cursor right.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): clear bit 6
PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): to END
regions.description: The grid cursor := x `$C0`, y `$90`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the bottom row: x = `$80` (FR)
regions.description: Does nothing but the end check (`$88F8`) - **FR moves the field cursor forward**, through `$8A93`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the bottom row: x = `$A0` (BA)
regions.description: `JSR $8A0B`: the field cursor moves back.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the bottom row: x = `$C0` (END)
regions.description: Any other x is a character (`$88E3`).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): END: decode
regions.description: `PLA / PLA / JMP $8516`: the editor ends, the decoder returns to its caller (carry clear: accepted).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: dispatch (`$893E`)
regions.description: Bit 3 (Up) -> `$8967`, bit 2 (Down) -> `$89B8`, bit 1 (Left) -> `$8A0B`, bit 0 (Right) -> `$8A93`; each routine moves the GRID cursor, or the FIELD cursor when B is held (`$0457` bit 6).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Up (`$8967`), grid
regions.description: y -16, with the wraps between the characters, the bottom row (`FR` / `BA` / `END` at x `$80`, `$A0`, `$C0`) and the top (RUN: Up from the top wrapped to the bottom row).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Up, field
regions.description: The field cursor's y -16 (to the first row); not above `$B8`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Down (`$89B8`), grid
regions.description: y +16 with the wraps (RUN: Down from the bottom row wrapped to the top).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Down, field
regions.description: The field cursor's y +16, not below `$C8`. RUN: B + Down moved it from y 184 to 200.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Left (`$8A0B`), grid
regions.description: x -16 (-24 across the gap); from the leftmost column to the rightmost (RUN: 48 -> 200, then 184, 168 ...). Also **the field cursor's 'back'** when called from BA.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Left, field
regions.description: The field cursor's x -8 (-16 across a gap between groups of four), not before x `$30`.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Right (`$8A93`), grid
regions.description: x +16 (+24 across the gap); from the rightmost column to the leftmost (RUN: 200 -> 48). Also **the field cursor's 'forward'**.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR, cursor moves: Right, field
regions.description: The field cursor's x +8 (+16 across a gap), not past the end. RUN: A on the first character moved the field cursor from x 48 to 56, B + Right from 64 to 72.

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the cursors' start (`$8B0F`)
regions.description: Eight bytes from `$8B1B` to `$0203-$020A`: sprite 1 (the grid cursor) y `$30`, tile 0, attribute 0, x `$30`; sprite 2 (the field cursor) y `$B8`, tile 0, attribute 0, x `$30`; `RTS`.

regions.name: Editor cursors' start (2 sprites)
PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): draw the grid (`$8B23`)
regions.description: From PPU `$2086`: the 64 characters 0-63 through `$86A8`, ten to a row with the blank after the fifth (X = 0, 2 ... 8, 11 ... 19), seven rows (the last has 4 characters).

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): the last row's words
regions.description: `JSR $C06F` with `0B 22 2F 'FR[ BA[ END'` (a bracket glyph is an arrow);

regions.name: PASSWORD EDITOR (`$887F`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.
